= camel kubernetes logs

Print the logs of a Kubernetes pod

NOTE: This command is provided by the `kubernetes` plugin. Install it with `camel plugin add kubernetes`.


== Usage

[source,bash]
----
camel kubernetes logs [options]
----



== Options

[cols="2,5,1,2",options="header"]
|===
| Option | Description | Default | Type
| `--container` | Name identifying the pod container to grab the logs from. |  | String
| `--kube-config` | Path to the kube config file to initialize Kubernetes client |  | String
| `--label` | Label name and value used as a pod selector. |  | String
| `--name` | The integration name. Use this when the name should not get derived otherwise. |  | String
| `--namespace,-n` | Namespace to use for all operations |  | String
| `--tail` | The number of lines from the end of the logs to show. Defaults to -1 to show all the lines. | -1 | int
| `-h,--help` | Display the help and sub-commands |  | boolean
|===
